name: TC_D12_InvalidCsrfToken
description: Sends a valid session but with a tampered form_key (CSRF token). If the server accepts the delete despite an invalid CSRF token, the SEC-001 gap applies to delete operations as well. Must not 5xx; logs the finding for security review.
